reasoning_content: The callback returned a 302. Let me check the Location to find out where it was redirected (probably to /admin/bootstrap/select-claim, or maybe to /admin/login?error=...).

action.command:
cd /tmp/nebu-bootstrap
CB_URL=$(cat callback_url.txt)
curl -s -b cookies.txt -c cookies.txt -D cbh.txt --max-time 20 "$CB_URL" -o callback_body.html
cat cbh.txt | head -6

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments:
{"command": "cd /tmp/nebu-bootstrap
CB_URL=$(cat callback_url.txt)
curl -s -b cookies.txt -c cookies.txt -D cbh.txt --max-time 20 "$CB_URL" -o callback_body.html
cat cbh.txt | head -6", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Check callback redirect target"}
